summary: Environment A evidence for the in-app enrollment workflow that lets an operator populate Phase 7.1's real audio fingerprinting manifest without hand-editing JSON or manually placing files.
auditFinding: No enrollment path existed - an operator would need to hand-write JSON matching local.rs's then-private manifest schema and manually place a WAV file at a path they referenced correctly. See docs/phase-7-2-audit.md and docs/phase-7-2-real-audio-fingerprinting-enrollment.md.
designChoice: No genuine architectural fork - this project had already solved the identical problem twice (Whisper model provisioning, Phase 3.8.7.1; embedding model/tokenizer provisioning, Phase 4.4), both via a native file picker + an install_* command that validates, copies, and logs 'restart to take effect'. This phase extends that exact pattern to a manifest with N entries instead of one fixed path.

newCode.localRs: integrations/music-acoustic/src/local.rs: Manifest/ManifestSong made pub with Serialize added; enroll_one's WAV validation extracted into shared decode_reference_wav; new pub validate_reference_wav/read_manifest_entries/write_manifest_entries.
newCode.commandsRs: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs: list_acoustic_enrollments and enroll_acoustic_reference(song_id, content_id, source_path), mirroring install_whisper_model/install_embedding_model_file exactly - validate, copy, upsert manifest by song_id, log restart-required.
newCode.frontend: domain/music.ts's AcousticEnrollment; commands.ts's listAcousticEnrollments/enrollAcousticReference; LiveChurchBrain.tsx's new 'Reference recordings for real audio fingerprinting' section (song search via existing searchMusic + native WAV file picker via @tauri-apps/plugin-dialog).

rustCrateTests: read_manifest_entries on a directory with no manifest is an empty list, not an error
read_manifest_entries on a nonexistent directory is an empty list, not an error
write then read manifest entries round-trips
write_manifest_entries creates the model directory if missing
write_manifest_entries fully replaces the previous contents (upsert semantics proven at the write layer)
validate_reference_wav accepts a real WAV file
validate_reference_wav rejects an empty WAV with zero samples
a file that passes validation also enrolls successfully - proves validate_reference_wav and enroll_one share one decode path

rejects listAcousticEnrollments/enrollAcousticReference outside the Tauri runtime, without calling invoke()

architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands beyond list_acoustic_enrollments/enroll_acoustic_reference, zero new events, zero new database schema.
core/music (the domain contract crate) is untouched.
NullAcousticMusicRecognizer/ScriptedAcousticMusicRecognizer and every existing acoustic-recognition code path are byte-identical to before this phase.

enroll_acoustic_reference never mutates AppState.acoustic_recognizer - the currently-active recognizer is unaffected until the next restart, exactly matching Whisper/embedding model install precedent.
honestLimitation: Removing an enrollment is not supported (only add/replace via re-enrolling the same song_id); no live re-recording from within the app (import an existing file only, matching every other model-provisioning flow in this codebase); still no real recorded audio anywhere in this repository or container to actually enroll for a genuine end-to-end test.
